texts.6d186810fb57:
Microbleeds and genetic risk factors to predict the risk of intracranial haemorrhage in patients treated with anticoagulation following stroke (CROMlS-2)

The aim of the study is to establish the value of microbleeds (MB) and genetic factors in predicting symptomatic ICH following anticoagulation to prevent recurrent ischaemic stroke due to artificial fibrillation (AF).

Data access is restricted to those named in section 7 of this agreement. Any changes will be notified to the NHS IC.
